adapter.name: HTTP Adapter
adapter.description: Allowlisted HTTP GET and POST network access behind the Action Gateway.

supported_actions.name: http_get
supported_actions.params_scope: allowlisted URL, optional trace-safe headers, bounded response size

supported_actions.name: http_post
supported_actions.params_scope: allowlisted URL, optional trace-safe headers, bounded request and response body

trace_behavior.evidence: Trace host, method, status, byte counts, duration, verifier reasons, and content type. Do not trace authorization headers, tokens, cookies, secrets, or unbounded response bodies.

replay_behavior.notes: Replay reconstructs HTTP decisions and outcomes from trace/state and does not reissue requests.

scopes.tenant_scope: required tenant_id with optional tenant-specific domain allowlist
scopes.agent_scope: required agent_id quota and permission scope
scopes.data_scope: declared URL and request body references only
scopes.network_scope: allowed domains, allowed methods, timeout, request byte limit, response byte limit
scopes.credential_scope: no ambient broad credentials; caller-provided secrets must be scoped and redacted

governance_support.approval: policy may require approval for external mutation or sensitive destinations
governance_support.policy_ttl: required where egress policy is policy-bundle controlled

limitations: Network-safe does not authorize open internet egress, arbitrary webhook mutation, or broad credential use.
No governance-aware claim is made unless deployment policy adds approval and circuit-breaker evidence.
No marketplace, legal certification, production support, or external-service certification claim.
